dedupe_keys.name: dubai municipality open data on dubai pulse building permits and floor information food consignments and tests sewage and treated effluent reuse heritage sites and makani geotags

description: Dubai Municipality publishes its open datasets on Dubai Pulse, the emirate's data platform, and lists them on its own open data page. The page read on 2026-09-28 groups them by theme. Construction datasets cover building permits, demolition permits, building usages, floor-level and summary information for each building, and project-level records. Food datasets include laboratory tests, health certificates and import and export consignments with origin, destination, product, inspection status and clearance. Environment datasets list wastewater generated from domestic sources and treated sewage effluent approved for reuse. Further datasets cover registered consumer products, community entrances and sectors, monthly visitors to heritage sites, and open data from the Makani smart geotagging system. Coverage is the Emirate of Dubai. Access is free; the terms on the page say data are published under the emirate's data laws, used at the user's own liability and must be cited, and no named open licence was read. Caveats: the datasets sit on Dubai Pulse, whose formats, fields and update frequency were not read, and some entries are administrative transaction lists. It supports city capacity and exposure studies, such as combining building floor information with permits to build a building stock model. Related record: the Dubai GNSS reference station network.
